versions.changelog:
- Initial release of guaikei-xiaohongshu-note-comment-tool.
- Enables fetching and analyzing recent Xiaohongshu (RED) notes, comments, and author activity by keyword or link.
- Supports four modes: keyword search, note detail (with comments), comment-only extraction, and author post monitoring.
- Outputs structured JSON for downstream analysis and reporting; saves logs for every execution.
- Includes input validation, error handling, and extensive usage documentation for streamlined trend and content research on Xiaohongshu.
